title: TokSuite: Measuring the Impact of Tokenizer Choice on Language Model Behavior

layout.note: Eight dashed cards in a 4 x 2 grid inside one large dashed frame: languages on the top row, perturbations on the bottom row; the two middle cards of the top row sit lower because the four tokenizer tags occupy the space above them; the doctor box and the wordmark sit on the frame's top edge.

lesson: Show one concept through many transformations: put the concept word on top and a grid of tabbed dashed cards beneath, each showing the same word translated or perturbed and cut into token chips, with one fixed colour per tokenizer so rows can be compared across cards.
